record.reason: LMK pooling divides token sequences into chunks with learned landmark tokens and reports improved dense-embedding/long-context behavior at modest added computation. This is a representation/pooling method rather than a model-serving optimization; the relevance to long-context LLM inference is possible but not demonstrated as reduced memory or latency.
record.title: LMK > CLS: Landmark Pooling for Dense Embeddings
